title: Performance Marketing Manager
description: About Bike Club We're customer obsessed. We put the customer at the heart of everything we do - and we're looking for people who feel the same way. Bike Club is changing the way families access children's bikes. Through our subscription model, we make it easy for families to get the right bike at the right time, while keeping bikes in circulation for longer. We are a purpose-led, fast-growing business with a strong focus on customer growth, retention and building a more circular approach to children's cycling. The Role We are looking for a commercially driven Performance Marketing Manager to manage and improve customer acquisition across the UK and Germany. Reporting to the Marketing Director, you will be responsible for the management of the performance marketing agency and overall delivery of our paid acquisition strategy. You will manage our agency partners, monitor channel performance and use customer and commercial data to recommend where we should invest, test and optimise. This role combines performance marketing expertise with strong commercial judgement. You will work closely with Marketing, Content, Data, Product, Finance and Commercial colleagues to improve the efficiency, quality and predictability of customer acquisition. You will be comfortable moving between strategic planning and detailed performance analysis, challenging agency recommendations and turning data into clear actions. Tasks What You'll Do - Acquisition Planning Develop and deliver Bike Club's customer acquisition plans across the UK and Germany in collaboration with the Marketing Director. Translate business objectives into channel plans, campaign targets and testing priorities. Recommend how acquisition budgets should be allocated across markets, channels and campaigns. Identify new opportunities to grow customer acquisition and market penetration. Develop a clear test-and-learn roadmap across channels, audiences, propositions, creative, and landing pages. Continuously assess the effectiveness and scalability of acquisition channels**.** - Performance Marketing Manage our performance marketing agency and other acquisition partners ensuring they deliver against agreed objectives. Oversee the day-to-day performance and optimisation of paid acquisition activity across relevant channels. Lead the restructure of paid search around parent needs and intent (sizing, outgrown bikes, exchange) rather than subscription terms. Review campaign plans, media spend, targeting, creative and results, constructively challenging agency recommendations where appropriate. Track customer acquisition cost, conversion, return on advertising spend and other key measures of performance. Focus acquisition activity on acquiring high-quality, sustainable customers rather than simply driving volume. Work closely with the content team to develop strong campaign propositions, briefs and creative testing plans. Identify opportunities to improve landing pages and customer journeys. Ensure learning from campaigns and tests is documented and applied to future activity. - Commercial Performance & Data Own day-to-day reporting on acquisition KPIs, including CAC, conversion, ROAS, payback and customer value. Partner closely with Finance and Data to understand acquisition economics and profitability. Analyse performance by channel, audience, campaign, proposition and market. Develop robust forecasting and scenario planning for acquisition performance for the Marketing Director and wider business Ensure performance data is accurate, accessible and used consistently in decision-making. Present findings and recommendations clearly to both marketing specialists and wider business stakeholders. Requirements About You You'll be an experienced performance marketer who combines channel knowledge with strong commercial and analytical judgement. You'll bring: Relevant experience in performance marketing, customer acquisition or growth marketing within a consumer-focused business or agency. A strong understanding of paid acquisition channels and how they work together within the customer journey. Experience managing performance marketing agencies or external partners. A track record of improving acquisition performance while maintaining commercial discipline. Strong analytical and commercial skills, with the ability to translate data into practical recommendations. Experience developing and evaluating campaign tests across audiences, creative, propositions or channels. Experience managing a multi-channel, multi-market budget of £1m+, including making investment recommendations A test-and-learn mindset and genuine curiosity about what drives customer behaviour. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Experience working across multiple markets, ideally including Germany is desirable. What Success Looks Like In your first 12 months, you will have: Delivered the acquisition plan in the UK and Germany hitting targets and establishing ways of working for future growth. Improved the efficiency and predictability of customer acquisition. Established clear acquisition KPIs and reporting. Built an effective and accountable relationship with our performance marketing agency. Developed a structured programme of testing across channels, audiences, propositions and creative. Identified and scaled the strongest acquisition opportunities. Improved collaboration between Marketing, Data, Product, Finance and Commercial teams. Benefits 🌴We offer 26 days per year + bank holidays 💷Pension salary sacrifice 🏡Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Leave 🚴Employee Discount on our bikes Why BikeClub? You'll be joining a business with a clear purpose, a genuinely different proposition and significant opportunity to grow. This is an opportunity to have a meaningful impact on the next stage of Bike Club's growth, while helping build a more sustainable way for families to access children's bikes. By the end of your rotations, you'll have the skills and experience to continue growing your career across Borrowing at Monzo.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You graduated in 2026 or are graduating in 2027 with, or expecting to achieve, at least a 2:1 in a STEM, Economics or another highly analytical degree. technologies</li> <li>You enjoy asking questions, digging into data and finding better ways to solve problems</li> <li>You want to build products that genuinely improve customers' financial lives</li> <li>You must have the permanent right to work in the UK, as we're unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role now or in the future</li> <li>You're able to work from our London office three days per week on a hybrid basis</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £50,000 base salary + incentive award tied to your performance</p> <p>📍 This role will be based in our London office on a hybrid basis (3 days per week in the office)</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>🎓 Training courses on programming languages like SQL & Python, alongside behavioural skills like effective communication and presenting data analysis.</p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, additional training courses and conferences.</p> <p>💻 Top-spec Macbook and accessories to use over the course of your time with us</p> <p>🧠 Knowledge-sharing sessions with your squad and wider discipline</p> <p>👯 Team and company wide socials / events</p> <p>🍝 Lunch on Monzo twice a week from a range of street food vendors</p> <p>➕ And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">here</a></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>Submit your application and answer a few short questions</li> <li>Complete an online exercise to showcase your analytical thinking and problem-solving skills (this will be sent out to eligible candidates once applications close) </li> <li>Join us for an in-person assessment centre (<strong>23rd November 2026</strong>). You'll meet people from across the team, take part in a series of interviews and learn more about what it's like to work at Monzo.</li> </ol> <p>Applications close at <strong>18:00</strong> <strong>PM on 27 September 2026</strong> but we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here</a>.<br>#LI-JH1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. title: Lead Product Manager, Payments
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. It’s how our customers move, receive, spend and manage their money, from cards and bank transfers to cross-border payments, merchant acquiring, payment experiences in the app, and the platform infrastructure that underpins the whole bank.</p> <p>This role sits in our Payments Platform area, working most closely with our Finance Infrastructure squad. The squad sits in Payments, but partners deeply with Finance teams to build the systems, abstractions and capabilities Monzo needs to operate safely, scale efficiently, and expand into new markets. You’ll work on foundational financial infrastructure: the ledgers, data, controls, reporting, reconciliation and platform capabilities that help Monzo understand, account for and manage money across the bank.</p> <p>This is a role for someone who gets genuinely excited by complex, technical infrastructure. The work is often behind the scenes, but it’s business-critical: it helps Monzo scale, launch new products and markets, support Finance, and keep the bank running safely.</p> <p> </p> <h4>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</h4> <ul> <li>Defining the product strategy and roadmap for Finance Infrastructure within Payments Platform.</li> <li>Partnering closely with Engineering, Finance and Payments leaders to understand what Monzo needs from its financial systems today and as we scale.</li> <li>Moving the team from reactive delivery towards a more strategic, product-led approach, asking why we’re building things, what good looks like, and how today’s choices support Monzo’s long-term needs.</li> <li>Translating complex finance, accounting, operational and regulatory needs into scalable platform capabilities.</li> <li>Prioritising across competing stakeholder needs, balancing urgent delivery with long-term system health.</li> <li>Helping Monzo build financial infrastructure that can support multiple products, entities, countries, currencies and regulatory environments.</li> <li>Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Finance, Engineering, Product and Operations.</li> <li>Bringing strong product discipline, technical curiosity and systems thinking to a space that is critical to Monzo’s future growth.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h4>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</h4> <ul> <li>You’re a strong senior Product Manager with experience owning complex technical, platform, infrastructure or financial systems.</li> <li>You have enough technical depth to partner credibly with engineers and reason about systems, trade-offs, dependencies and long-term architecture.</li> <li>You’re excited by “boring but critical” infrastructure, things like ledgers, reconciliation, financial data, controls, reporting, internal platforms, abstractions or backend systems.</li> <li>You can work with senior and cross-functional stakeholders, including Finance, Engineering, Product and operational teams.</li> <li>You’re comfortable bringing product thinking into ambiguous or stakeholder-heavy environments, and moving teams from request-led delivery towards long-term strategy.</li> <li>You’re high-agency, ambitious and excited to stretch yourself in a team with a high bar.</li> <li>You care about customers and business outcomes, even when the work is several layers removed from the end customer experience.<br><br></li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p> </p> <h4>🙌 What’s in it for you</h4> <p>💰 £125,000 - £145,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance ➕ equity</p> <p>✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK.</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor your visa. </p> <p>📍This role is hybrid working from our London office</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p> </p> <h4>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</h4> <ul> <li>First stage - Meet with our Collective Product Director</li> <li>Second stage - Meet with our Engineering and Finance leadership</li> <li>Third stage - Product full loop</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>If you’d prefer to work part-time, please let us know and we'll make this happen if we can.<br><br>#LI-HR1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. With Myprotein's slogan, <em data-start="420" data-end="440">Fuel your ambition</em>, at the heart of everything we do, we’re on a mission to be the world's most empowering health movement, championing everyone to live healthier, more active lives. Our brands and people exist to break boundaries, to power and empower those who want more.</p> <p data-start="143" data-end="197"><strong data-start="143" data-end="197">Why be a Senior Influencer Executive for Germany Myprotein?</strong></p> <p data-start="199" data-end="877">At Myprotein, we’re more than just a sports nutrition brand, we’re a global movement driven by passion, innovation and our mission to <em data-start="346" data-end="366">Fuel your ambition</em>. As Senior Influencer Executive for Germany, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the way our brand connects with an influential and growing fitness community. You’ll work alongside a passionate, high-performing marketing team and play a pivotal role in scaling our influencer strategy in one of our fastest-growing markets. This is a unique chance to blend creativity, strategic thinking, and cultural insight, all while working with some of the most exciting talent in the German fitness and wellbeing space.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities include:</strong></p> <ul> <li data-start="191" data-end="408">Own and drive the day-to-day operations of the German influencer programme, ensuring consistent growth and performance, while maintaining strong working relationships with creators and talent agents in the region.</li> <li data-start="412" data-end="587">Support the Senior Influencer Manager – EU in shaping and executing the German influencer strategy, aligning with overall EU and global objectives for the Myprotein brand.</li> <li data-start="591" data-end="815">Deliver detailed performance reporting on a weekly, bi-weekly, and monthly basis, analysing key KPIs including engagement, reach, conversions and ROI, and presenting insights and recommendations to internal stakeholders.</li> <li data-start="819" data-end="999">Manage programme maintenance, ensuring influencer tracking links, discount codes, and promotional offers are accurate, live, and performing optimally across all communications.</li> <li data-start="1003" data-end="1238">Actively source and recruit new German influencer talent, with a focus on brand alignment, commercial potential, and cultural fit – from micro creators to emerging macro talent – to support customer acquisition and brand awareness.</li> <li data-start="1242" data-end="1466">Collaborate cross-functionally with key stakeholders including content, brand, commercial, paid media and product marketing teams to plan, brief, and execute integrated influencer campaigns tailored to the German market.</li> <li data-start="1470" data-end="1636">Own the full campaign process for German influencer activations – from planning and briefing, to execution, approvals, content collection, analysis and learnings.</li> <li data-start="1640" data-end="1828">Ensure influencer content is on-brand, high quality and aligned with current German social media trends, fitness culture and seasonal campaigns, maintaining relevance and authenticity.</li> <li data-start="1832" data-end="2028">Lead on German influencer payments and budget tracking, ensuring accurate and timely invoicing and monthly purchase order (PO) processes are completed in line with internal finance procedures.</li> <li data-start="2032" data-end="2256">Encourage collaboration across influencer tiers, nurturing an engaged community through creative activations, collaborative content opportunities and connections with wider marketing channels (e.g., events, social, CRM).</li> <li data-start="2260" data-end="2416">Support brand-led events, campaigns and content creation, ensuring German influencer presence and involvement is maximised to generate impact and reach.</li> <li data-start="2420" data-end="2610">Stay ahead of industry trends in Germany , identifying emerging platforms, content formats, and creator trends to future-proof Myprotein’s influencer approach and maintain brand relevance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>We're looking for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Native level German language skills both written and spoken</li> <li>Business level English language skills both written and spoken</li> <li>Degree Qualified (Preferred)</li> <li>2+ year experience in Influencer marketing (preferred)</li> <li>A genuine interest in health, wellbeing, fitness and an ambition to be at the forefront of German influencer marketing</li> <li>An understanding of how influencers can play a key role in building brand awareness, affinity, content creation and driving commercial value for brands</li> <li>Deep knowledge of current and emerging German social media platforms including but not limited to Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok etc.</li> <li>Outstanding communication, negotiation and organisational skills</li> <li>A proactive self-starter with a problem-solving attitude and the ability to meet deadlines</li> <li>Knowledge of the German fitness industry and social media trends</li> </ul> title: Head of Data Engineering & Governance
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">About THG</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":160,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our portfolio of</span><span data-contrast="auto"> leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG. </span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p></div><p><strong>Location: Icon 1, WA15 0AF</strong></p> <p><strong>About Central Functions</strong></p> <p>Central Functions is formed of the teams and people that serve the entire business. These people are integral to the smooth running of the business; ensuring everyone is paid on time, that materials are sourced and arrive promptly, that we meet our legal obligations and that our health, safety, and security is safeguarded.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Why be the Head of Data Engineering and Governance at THG?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":160,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p>THG is building a world-class data function to power one of the UK's largest e-commerce businesses. As Head of Engineering & Governance, you will own the quality, availability and structure of the data that enables every business-facing team across our Beauty and Nutrition divisions.</p> <p>This is not a systems infrastructure role. You are not managing foundational platform plumbing — that sits with our technology partner, Ingenuity. Your remit is the layer above that: how data is structured, governed, made available and used across the business. You will set the direction for how THG gets the most from its data ecosystem, ensuring that analytics teams, data scientists, and business leaders can trust and act on the data they see.</p> <p>You will lead three distinct functions: Engineering (how we build, structure and maintain our data domains), Governance (how we ensure quality, consistency and trust), and Reporting (how we present business performance data consistently across PLC). You will work closely with Ingenuity, who provide the foundational platform and first-layer pipelines, to set requirements and standards that flow through from ingestion to insight.</p> <p>We are at an early stage of this journey. Our data foundations need significant work — we have talented analysts who have been doing engineering work without the structure or tools to do it well, governance that is essentially non-existent, and reporting that has grown organically without consistency. You will shape and deliver the roadmap that fixes this.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <p><strong>Strategic Direction</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set the vision and roadmap for data engineering, governance and reporting across THG PLC</li> <li>Define how data domains (Customer, Commercial, Operations) should be structured, stored and made available for analytics, data science and AI use cases</li> <li>Own the relationship with Ingenuity on platform and data matters — setting requirements, managing dependencies and ensuring PLC needs are reflected in the Ingen roadmap</li> <li>Evaluate where THG should use Ingen capability versus external tooling, and ensure every technology choice is documented and commercially justified</li> <li>Drive the business towards a single source of truth — reducing data silos, resolving mastering conflicts, and building confidence in our data across the organisation</li> </ul> <p><strong>Engineering & Data Platform</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the Engineering team in building and maintaining the data pipelines, domain datasets and platform architecture that underpin analytics across Beauty and Nutrition</li> <li>Own the evolution of our GCP/BigQuery platform — from how data is ingested and stored, to how it is structured for downstream consumption</li> <li>Set engineering standards — version control, testing, error handling, documentation — and ensure they are consistently applied</li> <li>Champion the use of AI and automation in data engineering — this is a small team that needs to move fast, and we expect the use of AI-assisted pipeline development and management to be embedded in how we work</li> </ul> <p><strong>Data Governance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the Data Governance function from a standing start — we have no established governance framework and this is a greenfield opportunity to build it properly</li> <li>Own the framework for how THG manages data quality, metadata, data definitions and lineage across PLC</li> <li>Work with Ingenuity to ensure governance standards are consistent across both PLC and Ingen data infrastructure</li> <li>Build the culture and processes that make governance a positive enabler rather than a compliance burden</li> </ul> <p><strong>Reporting & BI</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the consistency and quality of all business performance reporting across THG PLC — dashboards, KPI reports, executive-level views</li> <li>Ensure that any regularly used report or dashboard is owned, maintained and built to a consistent standard — no more ad hoc reporting that lives outside a managed framework</li> <li>Lead the evolution of our Tableau estate and assess when alternative or complementary tooling should be introduced</li> </ul> <p><strong>Leadership & People</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead, develop and retain a high-performing team across three functions — Engineering, Governance and Reporting</li> <li>Set clear direction and accountability for each function, developing your direct reports into leaders in their own right</li> <li>Build a culture of engineering excellence, curiosity and continuous improvement</li> <li>Influence and educate senior stakeholders across the business — building data literacy and trust in data assets</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">What skills and experience do I need for this role?</span></strong></p> <p><strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":160,"335559740":279}">Essential</span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience (typically 8+ years) in data engineering, data platform or data leadership roles, with at least 3 years at a senior or head-of level</li> <li>Deep hands-on experience with GCP and BigQuery — you must have built and scaled data platforms on this stack</li> <li>Experience across multiple data domains — ideally at least two of Customer, Commercial and Operations</li> <li>Proven track record of evolving a business's data architecture — you can point to concrete examples of how you changed the way a business ingests, stores and consumes its data</li> <li>Strong understanding of data governance principles — data quality, metadata management, mastering and lineage</li> <li>Experience working with or alongside a technology partner or platform team (similar to our Ingenuity relationship)</li> <li>Demonstrated use of AI in data engineering contexts — AI-assisted pipeline development, automated quality monitoring, or similar</li> <li>Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills — able to influence at Director and C-suite level</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in e-commerce, retail or consumer goods</li> <li>Familiarity with Dataform, dbt or equivalent transformation frameworks</li> <li>Experience with data cataloguing or governance tooling (Collibra, Alation, DataHub or equivalent)</li> <li>Exposure to ML/AI platform requirements — understanding what good data foundations look like to enable data science and personalisation</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">What’s in it for me?</span></strong></p> <p><strong>Career Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team.</li> <li>Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Enhanced Leave</strong></p> <ul> <li>25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.</li> <li>Don’t want to work on your birthday? We don’t either! Enjoy your day off on us!</li> <li>Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.</li> <li>Up to 10 days compassionate leave.</li> <li>Buy back up to 3 days each year.</li> <li>Unlock 2 days volunteer leave after 12-months.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wellbeing Support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP.</li> <li>Access our 247 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) which is provided by Bupa.</li> <li>State-of-the-art on-site gym.</li> <li>Access to our on-site physio.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Other Perks</strong></p> <ul> <li>Save up to 12% on the cost of personal tech through our salary sacrifice scheme.</li> <li>Subsidised bus pass from Manchester City Centre to our ICON office.</li> <li>Up to 50% staff discount on THG brands.</li> <li>On-site staff shop.</li> <li>Know someone who would be perfect for THG? title: DevOps Engineer

title: Director of Quality Assurance
description: At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world. The Role: As Director of Quality Assurance, you will lead our Quality function across three core areas: the quality management system, design quality assurance including software quality assurance, and supplier quality assurance including QC activities. As we approach on-market release, you will also prepare the QMS for customer facing activities including post-market surveillance and complaint handling. This is a player-coach role: hands-on leadership rather than pure people-management. You will set direction and develop the team, but you will also write procedures, make decisions, and stay close to the product and organisation needs. You will work as a direct partner to our engineering teams and alongside our dedicated Regulatory Affairs leadership. Regulatory is not part of this role, but a function you will collaborate closely with. At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day. Responsibilities: Team Leadership: Lead and develop our existing Quality team, instilling and maintaining a high performance culture. Ensure the CoMind QMS complies with the FDA QMSR (21 CFR Part 820, harmonised with ISO 13485) and 21 CFR Part 11 for electronic records and signatures, while remaining customer focused and aligned with business needs. Audit Leadership: Lead our annual ISO 13485 certification audit, FDA inspection readiness and own the internal, supplier, and customer audit programmes. Design Quality Assurance: Oversee design controls and design transfer to manufacturing including the DHFs and DHRs, ISO 14971 risk management, IEC 62366 useability, UDI requirement, and quality assurance across an integrated product spanning electronics, optics, and software. Provide oversight and guidance on software development processes including IEC 62304 software development processes, Software as Medical Device (SaMD) classification, and FDA's SaMD/AI-ML guidance. Cybersecurity: Provide oversight and guidance on cybersecurity aspects impacting product and business processes, including FDA's premarket cybersecurity guidance (Section 524B) Supplier & Manufacturing Quality: Lead supplier qualification, supplier audits, and manufacturing quality as we build toward commercial production. Work with suppliers to ensure effective Quality Assurance and Quality Control processes are implemented. Establish processes for maintaining Device Master Records, and transfer of batch records to CoMind. Post-Market Quality: Create the post-market side of the QMS from the ground up as we launch, including complaint handling, product analytics, and on-market quality processes Work with the RA function to compile Periodic Safety Update Reports (PSUR), vigilance reporting / MDR reporting, or field corrective actions/recalls in line with EU MDR/FDA obligations. Provide oversight and guidance on clinical evaluation / clinical data quality. Skills & Experience: Extensive leadership experience in Quality Assurance within an ISO 13485 environment including product design, manufacturing and commercial customer-facing operations A strong track record of building and managing high-performing Quality teams. Expert command of the core Quality toolkit: QMS, ISO 13485, design controls, ISO 14971 risk management, CAPA, validation, and supplier quality. Experience hosting and leading audits, including annual certification audits. Preferred audit certifications (ASQ CQE/CQA/CMQ-OE, RAC, Lead Auditor certification) Background in medical devices, ideally complex or integrated products. Strong candidates from diagnostics, IVD or pharma will also be considered. Experience in software-intensive / connected-devices Working knowledge of FDA / EU MDR and UK CA regulatory frameworks SaMD/software quality experience, human factors, or cybersecurity awareness A hands-on operator. You are comfortable writing SOPs and making decisions yourself, not just directing others. A record of staying and building - you are motivated by the journey and the chance to shape a function Benefits: Company equity plan so all employees share in the success of the company Salary-sacrifice pension scheme Private medical, dental and vision insurance (medical history disregarded) Group life assurance at 4x annual income Comprehensive mental health support, including unlimited access to 1:1 sessions with trained professionals Unlimited holiday allowance (+ bank holidays) and one week of remote working per quarter Lunch voucher (£10) every day for JustEat and free dinner on those days where you need to work later Twice weekly deliveries of fresh fruit and an extensive selection of snacks and drinks YuLife subscription, allowing you to turn your daily steps and meditation into discounts at a range of stores Compensation: £120K – £140K • Offers Equity • Salary £120K – £140K • Offers Equity Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.</p> <p>What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating<em> </em>our wins – big and small.</p> <p>Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, <a href="https://www.anaplan.com/careers/">values</a>-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!</p></div><p>At Anaplan, we are looking for a strong Senior Platform Engineer to join our team. </p> <p>Are you a creative problem solver who can both give and receive feedback? Do you lead with inclusion, collaboration, and openness? Do you have strong experience with high-scale B2B and B2C platforms?<br><br>As a Senior Platform Engineer, you'll be crafting and helping build the next generation of the Anaplan Platform. You’re comfortable with both full-stack systems design for the hybrid cloud as well as hands-on distributed systems programming with extensive knowledge of Java, JVM, Rust, Linux internals and container orchestration.</p> <p><br><strong>The Role</strong><br>We're looking for experienced engineers who've built real products at scale and apply that same rigor to platform engineering. You'll engineer new platforms as products, not just operate existing infrastructure. You understand user experience, reliability, and technical debt from shipping production systems. You'll design platforms that are extensible, observable, and maintainable, enabling internal teams to build on top of them while handling the complexity underneath.<br><br><strong>Your Impact</strong></p> <p><strong>Kubernetes Engineering & Automation</strong><br>You don't just write Helm charts or YAML manifests; you extend the Kubernetes API.</p> <ul> <li>Custom Operators: Proven ability to write Kubernetes Operators (using Kubebuilder or Operator SDK) to manage complex, stateful application lifecycles.</li> <li>Control Plane Logic: Deep understanding of reconciliation loops, custom resource definitions (CRDs), and how to automate operational knowledge into code</li> </ul> <p><strong>Scalable Microservices & Distributed Systems</strong><br>You build for high concurrency, low latency, and eventual consistency.</p> <ul> <li>High-Scale SaaS: 10+ years of experience building and operating production-grade SaaS products. You have first-hand experience with the "death by a thousand cuts" that<br>comes with scaling to millions of requests.</li> <li>Systems Programming: Advanced proficiency in Go, Rust, or JVM-based languages, with a focus on writing memory-efficient and thread-safe code.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Deep-Tier Cloud Storage & Persistence</strong><br>You understand the physics of data.</p> <ul> <li>Storage Internals: We need more than S3 API knowledge. You should understand the performance characteristics, limitations, and cost-drivers of S3, NFS, and enterprise<br>storage like NetApp OnTap or AWS FSx.</li> <li>Data Locality: Experience managing data persistence across hybrid environments (Public Cloud vs. Private DC).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Operational Maturity (The "SRE" DNA)</strong><br>You believe that "if it isn't monitored, it doesn't exist."</p> <ul> <li>Instrumentation: Expert-level experience with OpenTelemetry. You don't just look at metrics; you design the telemetry that allows for deep-dive distributed tracing and root-cause analysis.</li> <li>Observability Infrastructure: Hands-on experience scaling Prometheus and Grafana to<br>handle high-cardinality data.</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>Your Skills</strong><br>· BS degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience as a professional Platform Engineer.<br>· Substantial experience in Java, RUST programming experience<br>· Proven experience in building and operating a SaaS product at scale.<br>· Proven cloud experience using observability and operating workloads in Kubernetes.<br>· Experience with cloud storage S3, NFS, NetApp OnTap, AWS FSX<br>· Distributed Systems and programming techniques.<br>· Monitoring and metrics infrastructure (OTEL, Prometheus, Grafana).<br>· Cloud (AWS / GCP/ Azure / Private DC).<br>· Bonus: Experience with AI/ML, Natural Language</p> <p><strong>Technologies you’ll work with:</strong><br>· Programming languages: GoLang, Java11, Kotlin, Rust, Python<br>· Storage & Persistence: S3, NFS<br>· Container and Orchestration: Kubernetes/Containers (Docker)/Rancher RKE<br>· Cloud providers: AWS, GCP, Azure, Private Data Centers<br>· Observability/Telemetry: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana<br>· Deployment: Jenkins, ArgoCD</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) </strong></p> <p>We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. title: Founding Data Analyst
description: Our Mission Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance? Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist. We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world. We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them. The Role Dex runs on data. Our matching, our product decisions, our growth, our commercial bets all depend on understanding what's actually happening across the business, and right now that intelligence lives in too many places. This is a founding role to own the data foundation of Dex end to end: the data models underneath everything, the pipelines that connect our systems, and the data platform that the whole company (and our agents) builds on top of. We use agents for a huge amount of our analytical work, which means the quality of our data layer is a force multiplier. Get it right and every person and every agent at Dex gets faster and sharper. You'll own how data is modelled, how it flows between our systems, and how internal teams self-serve on top of it, building on what's already driving the business rather than starting from a blank page. As the first dedicated data hire, you'll set the standards and build the function out behind you as Dex grows. It's a chance to define how an AI-native company builds on its data from the ground up, in a market with a real dearth of well-built data foundations. We think there's a generational company to be built in this space, and we believe it's going to be Dex. What You’ll Do Core data modelling : Design and own the core data models that everything else depends on, making them clean, trusted and easy to build on. Modelling at source : Work inside the product and engineering codebase to ensure data is captured and structured correctly from the start, before it ever reaches the warehouse. Pipelines : Build and maintain the pipelines that connect our systems, so data flows through the business correctly and reliably. Self-serve platform : Make the data platform genuinely self-serve, so product, growth, commercial and ops teams (and our agents) can answer their own questions without coming to you. Agents as consumers : Treat agents as first-class consumers of the data layer, structuring data so they can do analytical work accurately and at scale. Metrics that matter : Partner with the team on the metrics that matter, from acquisition and activation through to matching quality and commercial performance. Answers, not just queries : Turn ambiguous business questions into the right data model, the right metric and a clear answer. Standards : Set the standards for data quality, definitions and instrumentation across Dex. What we’re looking for You've built the data foundation for a consumer product or marketplace before, and you know what good looks like at scale. You're an engineer and an analyst. You can model and pipe the data, and read what it's telling you about the business. Comfortable reading existing code and finding your way through a codebase you didn't write. You can pick up how a system models and emits its data, and confidently make changes within it. Fluent across a modern analytics stack (a cloud warehouse, a transformation layer, orchestration and BI), with views on what to use when. We're open to changing our current choices and want someone who can tell us where they're right and where they aren't. Commercially and product minded. You care about the metric and the decision it drives, not just the query. You think about the platform, not the one-off answer. You build things other people (and agents) can stand on. Intelligent, ambitious, with strong judgement. A good person who's fun to work with and makes things happen without being asked. What We Offer Above market salary — we're building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition Significant equity — we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take Full private healthcare & dental — because life happens and we want to support you Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support Gym membership & wellness benefits Claude tokens — lots and lots of Claude tokens Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip MacBook Pro + team kit "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support Interview process We move quickly and with conviction. Broadly you can expect: We love it when candidates have experimented with our agent, Dex. Even if you aren't an Engineer, you can get a sense of what we're building, and we love to hear your feedback. A 30m video call with our Internal Talent Lead; we'll share more about the team, role and business before asking questions about your experience and fit. Hiring Manager call: we'll share more specific context on short and medium-term objectives and ask deeper questions relative to the role requirements. Most roles involve a practical task to better understand how you work. Usually completed offline and reviewed by the team. Onsite interview loop where you'll visit the office, meet a cohort of the team, one interview centred on the task you produced, another on Dex culture and values, with a final interview with our Founder, Paddy. title: Platform Engineer
description: About us We love pets - which is why we're on a mission to make the world a better place for pets and their parents. We offer pet insurance policies with generous pet health benefits that are designed with their needs in mind. We've helped half a million pets stay happy and healthy since 2017 - and many more customers throughout the world are joining us every day. Our company is respectful, fun-loving and passionate about pets and their wellbeing. Throughout our business you'll meet people who think differently, aim for impact, and love to try new things. Want to join our pack? Join us. Love every moment. Love ManyPets. A day in the life As a Platform Engineer, you will join our platform squad. We build and maintain the AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, tooling and engineering standards that every other squad at ManyPets depends on. This role has a security focus. Much of your first year will be spent building the tooling that lets us demonstrate our security controls are working: automated compliance checks, reporting, and evidence collection to support our ISO 27001 commitments. Alongside that you will help us tighten access controls across our cloud estate, and take on ownership of the edge and network security tooling that protects our services. You will also work closely with our Head of Security as we build out a dedicated security capability at ManyPets. Our environment is fast-paced and highly collaborative. You will work closely with your teammates using pair or mob programming, participating in regular workshops and planning sessions, primarily over Zoom, with occasional in-person collaboration. We embrace modern development practices: All our services are cloud-hosted on AWS, using serverless and event-driven architectures for scalability and resilience. We use a fully automated deployment pipeline, allowing you to release to production within minutes, multiple times per day. We define our infrastructure as code, and we emphasise observability, testing and secure-by-design principles from the start. As a squad we own our work end-to-end, including development, maintenance and support. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and quality of what we provide to the rest of engineering, and contribute to a culture of rapid learning and continuous improvement. Your responsibilities ü Build and maintain secure platform foundations Design, build and maintain the shared cloud infrastructure, tooling and deployment pipelines that other squads rely on. Define infrastructure as code so our environments are consistent, repeatable and reviewable. Make secure configuration the default, so squads get it without having to ask for it. Maintain the edge and network security tooling that protects our services. Share in the day-to-day operational ownership of the platform, responding to requests and issues raised by other squads. ü Make our security controls provable Build automated checks that continuously test our cloud estate against our security and compliance requirements. Automate the collection and reporting of evidence for ISO 27001, replacing manual effort. Surface and report on gaps, drift and findings so they can be prioritised and resolved. Work with our Head of Security to turn written policy into controls that are enforced by tooling. ü Strengthen access and identity controls Review and tighten access across our cloud accounts, working towards least privilege. Improve how we manage secrets, credentials and machine identities. Make access changes auditable, and straightforward for engineers to request and for us to review. ü Extend our platform standards beyond AWS Help us apply the standards, tooling and controls we have built in AWS to our Google Cloud estate. Work with the teams who use Google Cloud to understand their needs and where the gaps are. ü Team collaboration Work closely with other squad members and stakeholders to align on goals and solutions. Support engineers across other squads who use our platform, and take their feedback seriously. Proactively build shared understanding across the team through pairing, discussions, and reviews. Document your work clearly to support knowledge sharing and future maintenance. ü Self development Take ownership of your learning journey and technical development plan. Approach challenges with curiosity and a growth mindset. Learn from your peers and actively seek feedback and mentorship. Your skills and experience We are looking for someone with: Commercial experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on a major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure). Hands-on experience defining infrastructure as code, using CDK, Terraform or similar. Experience building and maintaining continuous integration and deployment pipelines. A good working understanding of cloud security fundamentals, including identity and access management, secrets management, network controls and encryption. Proficiency in at least one scripting language, ideally Python. Comfort working in a regulated environment. We are FCA regulated and take our ISO 27001 commitments seriously. We would also like to see at least one of the following. You do not need both, and we will support you to build the other: A security specialism, such as cloud security posture management, security tooling, threat modelling or compliance automation. Experience across more than one cloud provider, ideally both AWS and Google Cloud. The interview process This position has a four-stage interview process, which will be held via Zoom. Stage 1 - an initial conversation with a member of our Talent team. Stage 2 - an informal meeting with the hiring manager for about 45 minutes. We will explain more about the role and explore how your experience matches up with what we need. Stage 3 - a longer interview, up to an hour, with the hiring manager and two engineers from the team. We will ask some competency questions and work through a technical scenario together. There is no take-home exercise. Stage 4 - an informal conversation with our Head of Security. About the team The EPD ("Engineering, Product and Design") team operates with a squad system and Agile ways of working within quarterly terms - and we really enjoy working collaboratively. We hold regular 'Hack Weeks' to look at products and address problems relating to the business, and we get the chance to highlight and work on things we're interested in and feel passionately about. Our tech stack We are on a mission to become the best we can be, constantly challenging ourselves to achieve and learn. You will be supported to learn new technology – both in breadth and depth - and encouraged to challenge our ways of thinking with new and innovative ideas. Our "north star" is to become an elite performer as defined by the 4 key DORA metrics. To drive towards elite status, we apply and continually inspect and adapt the best Agile frameworks and practices inspired by DevOps, SRE, Scrum, XP and Lean. We are a highly collaborative environment and regularly practice Mob and Pair based programming which we believe improve our quality of delivery and share understanding. We take our operational performance, security, and reliability as seriously as our quality and development practices. We are cloud hosted and highly automated, primarily on AWS with some critical services running on Google Cloud. Some specific technologies we use include: AWS | Google Cloud | Python | CDK | GitHub Actions | MongoDB | Aikido | Cloudflare Salary range: £55,000 — £65,000 GBP Ways of working On a typical day you'll be working from a laptop with a screen, mouse, keyboard, and headset. You'll be meeting your colleagues on Zoom and keeping in touch regularly via email and Slack too – we'd expect you to be using your computer for around seven hours a day. We'd ask that you have a distraction-free work area and a reliable internet connection with a speed of 25Mbps so you can work effectively. We'll make sure you have the right home set-up that supports you in the role by providing best-in-class technology, money towards a desk, and vision support. Inclusion at ManyPets We promise to give you the same opportunities as everyone else and we won't discriminate against you at any point in the process. This includes how we source talent, our interview process, our conditions of employment (including pay) and feedback. If you'd like to read more about this, please download our Approach to Inclusion policy. Reasonable adjustments and support If you need any help, support, or advice at any point during the hiring process please email Connect with us! title: Senior New Business Manager
description: About WPP Production We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world. About WPP WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com . A Hybrid working model We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. What does a Senior New Business Manager do at WPP Production? The role The Senior New Business Manager plays a critical role in driving growth for WPP Production, leading complex, high-value opportunities end-to-end and shaping how we respond to and win new business. This is a strategic and creative role, responsible for defining the narrative, positioning and overall solution behind each pitch. You will take ownership of how we translate client challenges into clear, differentiated and commercially compelling responses. Working closely with senior stakeholders across WPP Production and the wider WPP network, you will lead the development of integrated proposals — bringing together strategy, operations, creative and production into a single, cohesive story. You will also help shape the strategic approach for each opportunity, ensuring the structure, messaging and positioning reflect WPP Production's proposition and competitive advantage. You will balance creative thinking with commercial understanding — clearly articulating how our operating models work, why they are effective, and the value they deliver for clients. This is an opportunity to work on some of the most exciting and complex opportunities in the industry, with real influence over how we position ourselves and how we win. Key areas of responsibility Lead and own high-value opportunities end-to-end, from initial brief through to submission and presentation Define the pitch narrative, positioning and "red thread", ensuring a clear, compelling & cohesive story throughout Design and articulate client solutions, including operating models and value propositions, clearly demonstrating how they work and the value they deliver Translate complex inputs into clear, structured and persuasive client-facing responses Lead the development of high impact written content, including pitch decks, RFI/RFP responses and presentations, owning the narrative across all content Present and support client-facing sessions, including credentials presentations and pitch meetings Lead and align senior stakeholders around a single, cohesive response Build strong relationships with key stakeholders across WPP Production, WPP OpCos and partners, enabling effective collaboration across opportunities Ensure all outputs are strategically strong, consistent and clearly differentiated Collaborate across WPP agencies on integrated, multi-disciplinary opportunities Contribute to and help shape commercial strategy, including pricing narrative and value framing Monitor competitor activity and industry trends to ensure WPP Production's positioning remains competitive Identify opportunities to improve & drive innovation in how we approach, structure and deliver pitches Mentor and support New Business Managers and Executives, raising standards across the team What good looks like (key requirements) 7+ years' experience in a new business or client growth roles within a creative, production or agency environment Exceptional writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to shape clear, persuasive narratives from complex inputs Strong strategic thinking, able to translate client challenges into structured, compelling solutions and responses Proven experience leading complex pitch or proposal processes end-to-end Confident communicator, with experience presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple high-value opportunities and large volumes of content simultaneously Strong commercial capability, with experience shaping proposals and contributing to pricing approach, value framing and commercial models Proactive and solutions-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership and a drive to identify opportunities and deliver outcomes Collaborative in approach, able to bring together multiple stakeholders and disciplines into a single aligned response Strong understanding of the advertising production landscape and broader marketing ecosystem Curious and engaged, with an interest in innovation and the evolving content and production landscape Strong working knowledge of PowerPoint, Word and Excel, with a good eye for structure and presentation #LI - HYBRID #LI - RH1 Why work here: At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment. title: Backend Engineer, Subscriptions
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, one of the largest online food ordering and delivery platforms in the world. As part of this role, you'll join one of our Subscriptions teams in London, focused on the core proposition and working across our three subscription programmes - DashPass, Deliveroo Plus, and Wolt+. You'll work closely with engineering teams across the US and Europe, as part of the Global Subscription organisation, to build and evolve the shared subscriptions capabilities that power loyalty and membership experiences for millions of customers worldwide. We're hiring backend engineers who want to be at the front line of what engineering looks like in the age of AI. 💡 Why Subscriptions? An AI-first team by design. We don't use AI as a productivity add-on - we treat agentic coding as a core engineering discipline. We expect our engineers to build with AI agents, to challenge what's possible when the human-in-the-loop is a multiplier rather than a bottleneck, and to push the boundaries of what a small, focused team can ship. Real ownership, real impact. Our subscription programmes are touching millions of users daily. You'll own features end-to-end - from the idea through production - and see your work matter at scale. Cross-org engineering at the frontier. Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt are working together in order to align subscription experiences across three of the world's leading delivery platforms. This is engineering at the intersection of product ambition and international complexity. A small team that punches above its weight. We're a cross-functional team: Backend, Mobile, Web, Product, Design, and Data - all in the same room. No handoff theatre. You'll move fast, ship iteratively, and be around people who take craft seriously. 🤖 AI-First Engineering - What This Means Here We're building teams at the forefront of agentic coding. This isn't about using Copilot to autocomplete boilerplate. We mean engineers who: Design workflows where AI agents handle entire task loops, from spec to PR. Think in terms of orchestration: what does a human review, what does the agent own? Build internal tooling and abstractions that make AI-assisted development faster and more reliable for the whole team. Stay curious and ahead of the curve - trying new models, agents, and tools as they emerge, and forming strong opinions about what's genuinely useful vs. hype. If you find yourself naturally asking "can an agent do this?" before reaching for the keyboard, you'll fit right in. 🔍 What We're Looking For Across all roles Strong engineering fundamentals - you've built and shipped software that runs at scale, and you understand what that entails: testing, observability, reliability, and maintainability. Genuine enthusiasm for AI-first development. You use AI tools daily and have formed real opinions about how to get the most out of them. Ownership mentality: you drive projects forward, communicate clearly across teams and time zones, and don't wait to be told what to do. Collaborative instincts - the Subscriptions domain sits at the intersection of consumer mobile, web, backend, and data. Cross-functional work is the norm, not the exception. 🙌 About You You've built and shipped real software - products, platforms, APIs, apps - and you know what it takes to keep things running reliably in production. You have opinions about architecture but hold them lightly. You write tests. You read the alerts. You don't leave loose ends. What sets you apart right now is that you're genuinely excited about where engineering is going. You've been experimenting with AI agents and agentic coding workflows - not because someone told you to, but because you couldn't help yourself. You think about how to redesign your development loop from first principles, not how to bolt AI onto the way you already work. You communicate well, collaborate easily across disciplines, and care about the product as much as the code. You're the kind of engineer who asks "what's the best way to..." and then actually follows through. 🌍 Where You'll Work These roles are based in our tech hub in London. description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. Our aim is to be the leading global provider of solutions that enable customers to release £30bn of value per annum from distributed energy resources (DERs). We are building a Software as a Service (SaaS) subscription business with a global addressable market of £2.4 billion per annum, by digitally connecting hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. We have already attained a market leading position and Kraken is a recognised thought leader and innovator in the industry. 🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and growth, we're looking for a Generation Flex Delivery Manager to own the successful onboarding of flexible generation and energy assets onto KrakenFlex across the EU. This is a customer-facing delivery role with a strong technical bias. You'll manage an asset through the full onboarding journey, from initial discovery and technical analysis, through site design and gateway installation, to commissioning, testing and handover into live service. You'll sit at the intersection of our customers, Electrical Engineering, Product and Customer Success Engineering teams. You'll need to understand both the connectivity and control architecture of our customers' assets and how those assets connect to and operate through the KrakenFlex SaaS platform . You won't be expected to design the details of the integration solution or write the software yourself. Instead, you'll need enough technical depth across both areas to understand how they fit together, identify gaps and risks, challenge incomplete information and drive the right conversations to get a site successfully integrated. Your role is to bring together three perspectives throughout onboarding: Customer : What is the customer trying to achieve, and what do we need from them? Product : How will the asset operate within KrakenFlex, and what product capabilities and configuration are required? Engineering : How does the physical asset need to be integrated, connected and commissioned to make that solution work? Your job is to make sure those three come together as one successfully delivered customer solution . 🚀 What you'll own Own the end-to-end onboarding and delivery of Generation Flex assets BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar), from initial onboarding through analysis, site design, installation, configuration, commissioning, testing and handover into live service. Understand how the physical site and its electrical/control systems connect into the KrakenFlex software architecture, and bring those two worlds together throughout onboarding. Work closely with Product and Software Engineering teams to understand the relevant GenFlex capabilities, product modules, configuration requirements and technical constraints for each customer and asset. Translate between customer requirements, electrical engineering requirements and SaaS/product requirements , making sure each group understands what is needed from the others. Understand the end-to-end data and control path from the physical asset through site controls, meters, PPCs, gateways and communications infrastructure into Kraken Flex, and from Kraken Flex back to the asset where control is required. Ensure that the customer's intended use of the GenFlex product is reflected in the technical onboarding solution, including the required telemetry, controls, configuration, integrations and product modules. Be able to explain to customers how their site will interact with KrakenFlex, both from a physical integration perspective and from a software/product perspective. Work with Product teams to identify where customer or asset requirements do not fit current product capabilities, and ensure gaps, constraints or product dependencies are surfaced early. Feed recurring onboarding challenges, customer requirements and technical integration pain points back into Product and Engineering teams to help improve and scale the GenFlex proposition. Be the primary delivery point of contact for customers during site onboarding, setting clear expectations around what we need from them, what Kraken is delivering and what needs to happen next. Work closely with our Electrical Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams to ensure the technical information required to integrate a site is complete, accurate and available at the right stage of delivery. Review and interpret customer technical documentation including: Electrical Single Line Diagrams (SLDs) Network and communications diagrams Site and asset specifications PPC and controller documentation Modbus register maps IP addressing and network information Functional Design Specifications Metering and telemetry information Hardware and connectivity requirements Be confident discussing technical site architecture with customers and engineers, understanding how equipment such as generators, batteries, meters, PPCs, controllers, gateways and site networks fit together. Identify missing, inconsistent or technically unclear customer information early and drive it to resolution before it becomes a delivery blocker. Coordinate the preparation and review of Kraken integration documentation, including gateway architecture, communications diagrams, Kraken SLDs, integration designs and site configuration information. Coordinate the Kraken Gateway delivery and installation process , ensuring prerequisites such as power, networking, connectivity and installation arrangements are understood and ready. Manage readiness for key commissioning and testing activities, including: Gateway installation and connectivity Operational acceptance testing Kraken market and service testing Proactively manage delivery risks and communicate issues and mitigation plans clearly to internal and external stakeholders. Surface blockers early and drive the right people together to resolve them rather than allowing issues to sit between teams. Maintain clear visibility of the status and health of each site, including technical readiness, product readiness, customer actions, Kraken actions and upcoming milestones. Continuously improve the Generation Flex onboarding process, identifying recurring technical, product or customer blockers and working with Engineering, Product and Operations teams to remove them. 🧠 What you'll bring to the party A strong technical background and the confidence to work closely with electrical, control systems, and networking. The ability to read and understand an Electrical Single Line Diagram (SLD) and use it to understand the electrical architecture of a site. A practical understanding of industrial networking and communications , including concepts such as IP addressing, LANs, routers, switches, VPNs and site connectivity. Enough electrical engineering knowledge to understand concepts such as metering, breakers, transformers, generators, inverters, batteries and asset control systems. Experience delivering technical projects involving the integration, commissioning or onboarding of physical assets, ideally within energy, renewables, utilities, industrial automation, controls or a similar environment. Excellent communication skills , with the ability to take a complicated technical problem and clearly explain the issue, impact, owner and next action. Experience coordinating multiple teams and dependencies across customers, Electrical Engineering, hardware, installation partners and other third parties. A highly organised approach to delivery, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple sites at different stages of onboarding simultaneously. The ability to proactively identify risk, remove blockers and maintain momentum in an environment where customer readiness and site timelines can change quickly. A customer-centric mindset and a drive to provide an outstanding onboarding experience without compromising technical quality. A pragmatic, collaborative approach and the confidence to operate in a fast-moving environment where processes and products are still evolving. A strong interest in understanding how a SaaS product works end-to-end , rather than treating the software platform as a black box. A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment , comfortable navigating the complexity and comfortable being the regional face of site onboarding function. Language: professional fluency in English . A second European language would be preferable. ⭐️ Bonus points Experience in APIs, data flows, system integrations or cloud software architecture would be beneficial. Experience in flexible generation, battery storage, renewable energy, demand response or distributed energy resources. A working understanding of industrial communication protocols and controlled environments would be helpful (e.g. modbus, OPC UA ) Experience commissioning or integrating generators, BESS, solar, EV infrastructure or other industrial energy assets. Previous experience working with grid-connected assets, control systems or energy market services. Experience with SaaS implementation, technical product onboarding or systems integration. Familiarity with commissioning processes and the distinction between cold commissioning, energisation and hot commissioning. Experience with industrial gateways, edge devices or IoT connectivity. Wider retention and growth outcomes will be shared with the teams responsible for them.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What you will bring</strong></p> <p> </p> <ul> <li> <p>A track record of independently building and improving B2B content programmes, with examples of measurable results.</p> </li> <li> <p>Excellent writing, editing and interviewing skills, supported by a portfolio of substantive work such as case studies, editorial programmes, reports or campaigns.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience leading campaigns across functions, including setting priorities, resolving competing requests and coordinating delivery.</p> </li> <li> <p>Confidence using analytics and research to make decisions, define success and explain the limits of attribution.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong commercial judgement and the ability to turn complex product or operational information into useful merchant content.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience adapting content across markets, working with specialists and managing external contributors.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience in marketplaces, merchant services, hospitality, retail or B2B technology would be valuable.</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Why Join Us?</strong></p> <div style="min-height: 1.2em; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0;"> </div> <p>At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition.
